text: Caught up with Divya over lunch. Her son Anil starts reception on September 4th and she's already dreading the drop off. Her husband's taking the morning off to go with them. Anil's apparently very excited about his new lunchbox and has already picked which peg he wants. Divya's going back to work full time the week after, which is part of the stress. Remind me to text her that afternoon to see how it went, and maybe again on the Friday.

Hannah rang. Their old cat Biscuit has kidney problems and the vet wants to see him again Thursday at 10am. She sounded wiped out. Her partner Yaw is doing the vet run so she can work. Biscuit is 17 so they're preparing themselves for bad news, and Hannah said she isn't sure she can face another round of tests. Yaw's sister Adaeze offered to have their other cat for a bit. I should ring Hannah on Thursday evening.
Kiara's dad passed away on Sunday. Funeral is Oct 29 at 11 at St Mark's. She said Jada's helping with the flowers. I'm driving Mum there. Need to send Kiara a card before then.

Long chat with Dong after squash. He got made redundant last week, along with half his team. He's weirdly calm about it, says he wants to retrain as a teacher. His wife Emily is less calm. They've got the mortgage renewal coming up in January and Emily's worried the bank won't play ball without a payslip. Dong has a careers advice session on November 6 at 10am and has already signed up for an open evening at the uni. Remind me to send him Marcus's number, Marcus did the same switch a few years back.
Julien and Sophie got a puppy!! Cockapoo called Pickle, eight weeks old, picked her up yesterday evening. Julien says she's already chewed a shoe.
Oliver graduates from Leeds on July 18th, ceremony at 2pm. His mum Adaeze is flying over from Lagos for it. Don't forget to get him something, he mentioned wanting a decent pair of headphones.

Bumped into Chris at the school gates. His daughter has her 11+ on the 12th at half 9 and is a bag of nerves about it. Chris isn't sleeping much either. Chris says she's fine with English but freezes on the maths, and they've been doing past papers every night after tea. Results come out mid October. His son's doing the same thing in two years so this is the trial run. Text her good luck the night before?
Tendai and his girlfriend split up. Five years together. He's moved back in with his brother Lwazi for now. Seemed ok on the surface but kept going quiet. I should check in on him next week.
Vikram's lab Rolo turns 10 on Saturday and they're doing a dog party in the park, Saturday at 3. Honestly. Keisha's baking a dog cake.
dentist moved to Tues 8:40am, pick up dry cleaning after
Tiago got his GCSE results this morning, all 7s and 8s apparently. Anan was beaming at pickup. Must send congrats to Tiago, maybe a fiver in a card.

Emily called about Jonah. He's got his first day at nursery Monday morning and she's more anxious than he is. Her mum is coming down on Sunday to help. Remind me to ask her Monday night how he settled.
Tamar's mum died in the summer and the stone setting is August 9th at 11am. Lior asked if we'd come. We are going, I've booked the day off.

Niamh said the wedding's off. She and Callum broke up a couple of weeks ago, she found out about some stuff. She's staying at her sister Rin's place in Bristol. Need to call her this weekend, not text. She mentioned the venue deposit is gone and her parents are trying to get some of it back from the caterer. Rin's been taking her out on long walks with the dog. Niamh also said she's going to take some time off work in November, maybe go to Galway for a week.
Rin's rabbit escaped again. Found it in next door's garden. Very funny story but no harm done.

Bogdan's last day at the warehouse was Friday, they shut the whole site. He had leaving drinks at the Crown, which I missed. Has an interview at Amazon on 11/3 at 1pm. He's been at that site eleven years so it's a lot. His wife's due in the spring which isn't helping the stress. I should text him good luck the morning of, and ask Vikram if there's anything going at his place.

Zeynep's kids both start at the new school after half term. Her eldest is nervous about making friends. Zeynep's husband Marcus got a job in Reading so that's why they moved. She loves the new house though, big garden.
Luis graduated! Masters in civil engineering, ceremony was yesterday at 4. Wei sent me the photos. Remind me to get him a card and maybe a bottle of something nice.
Quick one: Divya's cat Mango is having a tooth out on Friday at 9am. She's worried about the anaesthetic because he's 14.

Chat with Hannah and Yaw at the barbecue. Yaw's brother Jonah is getting married on June 3rd in Accra and they're flying out on the 28th. Hannah's never been to Ghana, she's excited. They need someone to feed their fish, and I said I would.
Anil passed his driving test this morning on the second go!! Divya says he's insufferable already. Don't forget to congratulate him when I see him Sunday.

Kiara's been really low since the breakup. She's not eating much and called in sick twice this week. Her sister Jada is staying with her. I need to take her out for a coffee, maybe Thursday after work.
Jada starts her new job at the council on 9/15. She's been out of work since the redundancy in March so this is a big deal.
Dong's grandad died last night. He's flying to Shanghai tomorrow at 6am for the funeral, back maybe the 30th. Remind me to message him while he's out there, just to check he's ok.
Julien loves Formula 1, like proper obsessed, watches every qualifying session. Also he's vegetarian now, Sophie's influence.
Oliver's dog Bramble has to be put down. Vet's coming to the house Wednesday at 5. He's gutted, had her since uni. Should drop off something, maybe flowers for him and Adaeze.
Adaeze's daughter got into Cambridge, results came through this morning. Adaeze cried telling me. Must send her girl a congrats card.

Called Chris back. Sounds like the redundancy consultation is on Tuesday at 2pm and he thinks he's on the list. His wife's due in December which makes it all worse. He's already been looking at contract work but doesn't want to move cities with a newborn coming. Their eldest, the one who did the 11+, doesn't know yet. Ring him Tuesday evening, and don't forget to bring up the job at Luis's firm.
Tendai's dad retired at the end of last month after 40 years on the buses. Lwazi says there's a party for him on the 21st at their uncle's, 7pm. Tendai asked if I'd come.
food shop sunday morning, then car wash. gym 6pm.

Vikram's mum is in hospital, a fall, broken hip. Op is tomorrow morning. Vikram's going up to Leicester tonight. Keisha's holding the fort with the kids. Text him tomorrow afternoon to ask how the op went.
Keisha's twins finished primary today. Leavers' assembly was at 2. She sent a video of them doing the dance, absolutely mortifying for them. Secondary starts September 3rd.
Tiago was telling me about his tortoise, Gerald, who is apparently 52 years old and older than his dad. Tiago wants to be a vet.
Anan's stepdad passed away on Monday. She's ok but tired, lots of admin. Funeral not set yet. Her partner Wei is handling the house. Need to drop round some food this week.
Emily and Jonah have a new kitten, Smudge. Jonah named it. Emily says the kitten has already climbed the curtains twice.

Sophie got laid off on Friday morning, no warning, they just called everyone into a meeting at 9. She's fine she says, has savings and was looking anyway. Julien's more rattled than she is. Don't forget to send her that recruiter's details.
Lwazi Mensah's graduation is May 14 at 10:30, then a family lunch. He's the first in their family to go to uni. Tendai's dropping hints that Lwazi would love a new laptop bag.
Tamar texted. Her dog Pepper is back from the vet after the lump op, all benign. Relief all round.
Lior's daughter has her ballet exam on the 22nd at 4:15. Tamar says she's been practising every night in the kitchen. Remind me to ask Lior how she did.
Spoke to Niamh again. She's doing a bit better, started counselling, and her sister Rin has been amazing. She's thinking about moving to Dublin in the new year. Asked me not to mention Callum.
Callum Hughes, the one from five-a-side, said his son starts Year 1 tomorrow and has a new teacher he's scared of. Callum's doing drop off at 8:45.
Bogdan's wife had the baby! Little boy, born 3:12am on Tuesday. Bogdan's on paternity leave until Nov 20. Need to sort a present, she said they need nothing but nappies.
Zeynep's guinea pig died, the kids are devastated. They're having a little garden funeral for it Saturday morning, Marcus is digging the hole. Bless them.
Marcus and Zeynep's anniversary is June 10, 15 years. Zeynep wants to go to Lisbon but Marcus doesn't know yet. She hinted he should book it.
Luis's mum Mrs Barros is having her knee done on 12/2 at 7am. He'll be off work that week to look after her. I should check in midweek.
Wei mentioned he's really into bouldering now, three times a week, and wants to do an outdoor trip to Font next spring. Also hates coriander, noted for the dinner.

Divya and Anil are doing a big joint party for their parents' 40th on Saturday 8th at 7. Tiago and Anan are coming too. I'm bringing the dessert. Divya says her dad wants a new watch, if we're chipping in.

Hannah's grandmother died on Thursday night. Hannah's going to Cork for the funeral, flight is Monday at 7am, back Thursday. She asked if I could water the plants. Send her a message Monday evening to see how she's holding up.
Kiara's niece is doing her SATs this week and Kiara's been helping her revise every evening. She's terrified of the maths paper on Wednesday morning.

Talked to Jada and Dong at the pub. Jada's kid lost her first tooth, the tooth fairy paid a whole two quid. Dong's back from Shanghai, says the funeral was really hard but he's glad he went. Jada's moving flats on the 1st, from Peckham to a two-bed in Lewisham, so her daughter finally gets her own room. Dong offered his van. He also said his mum is coming to stay with them in December for a month, first time since his grandad died.
Julien's cat Moustache went missing Sunday night. Sophie's put posters up everywhere. Julien is beside himself. Remind me to share the post in the village Facebook group tonight.
Oliver's interview went well apparently, he'll know by Friday at 5. This is the one in Manchester. Adaeze said he barely slept the night before. Ask him Friday evening what they said.

Chris's dad's funeral was on Thursday. He said it went as well as it could, lots of people came. He's taking next week off. Check on him a couple of weeks from now when everyone else has stopped asking.

Tendai and Keisha both came to the quiz. Tendai said his redundancy money came through and he's going travelling, Vietnam and Cambodia, flies out Jan 9 at 10pm. Keisha's covering his rent while he's away by subletting.
Vikram's eldest graduates from Bath on July 21st at 11. Vikram's taking the whole family. He also mentioned their new puppy, Ziggy, is going to his sister's while they're away.
Keisha's dog Coco had puppies, six of them, on Sunday night! She's keeping one and selling the rest. Asked if I want one. I don't. I really do.
Tiago's uncle lost his job at the factory and is moving back to Porto. Tiago is pretty upset, they're close. The leaving do is next Friday at 8.

Anan had a rough week. Her dog Lola died suddenly on Tuesday and then her boss announced restructuring. She's worried about her role, the meeting's Thursday at 11. Wei says she's not sleeping. Lola was twelve and they'd had her since she was a pup, so it's hit both of them hard. Wei's been working from home to be around. Anan says if the restructure goes badly she might take it as a sign and go freelance. Text her Thursday at lunch to check in.
Emily's 40th is Nov 4. Jonah and her sister are planning a surprise dinner on the 2nd at 7:30. Emily keeps saying she wants a proper camera. Don't forget to tell Jonah I'm in for a contribution.

Long catch up with Sophie, Julien and their friend Lior. Sophie's started a new job after the layoff, a design agency in town, really likes it. Julien's training for the Brighton half in April. Lior's son starts uni in York in September and Lior is not coping well with the idea of an empty house. Pickle the puppy is now enormous and has been banned from the sofa. Sophie wants us all round for dinner on the 18th at 7. I said I'll bring wine.
